personal.preferred_title: Observability Platform Engineer | Telemetry, APM, Python Automation & Cloud Monitoring

summary: Observability and performance engineer with deep enterprise APM, telemetry, dashboarding, alerting, RCA, and automation experience in large-scale banking and enterprise environments. At Citi, built Python, SQL, Pandas, and PySpark workflows that converted telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints into dashboards, capacity forecasts, reliability reports, and operational insights. Strong hands-on foundation with Dynatrace AppMon/Synthetics, CA APM/Introscope, AppDynamics, BMC TrueSight/TSCO, Python/shell automation, production troubleshooting, cloud-oriented monitoring workflows, and modern observability tools including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Terraform/IaC ramp-up.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Supported enterprise observability, capacity, and reliability workflows across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, AWS-backed reporting layers, and infrastructure telemetry from 6,000+ endpoints.
Built Python, Pandas, PySpark, and SQL workflows that transformed telemetry into validated dashboards, KPI reports, forecasting datasets, operational insights, and reliability decision support.
Analyzed utilization trends, latency symptoms, missing feeds, abnormal metric movement, and reporting discrepancies to identify bottleneck risk, reliability concerns, and capacity pressure.
Created validation checks for telemetry freshness, row counts, missing data, unmatched records, abnormal deltas, and output consistency to improve confidence in monitoring and reporting data.
Troubleshot production issues by tracing source feeds, metric behavior, Python processing, SQL transformations, failed outputs, latency symptoms, and downstream reporting discrepancies.
Developed runbooks, metric definitions, dashboard notes, data-flow documentation, validation checkpoints, and support procedures to improve repeatable operational response.
Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, engineering, and business teams to explain telemetry findings, coordinate fixes, and improve production reliability.
Used AWS S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, EC2/ECS concepts, Python, SQL, and monitoring data to support cloud-oriented observability, automation, and reporting patterns.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems, improving visibility into user-facing reliability and performance.
Correlated real-user monitoring, synthetic transaction data, and load-test behavior to identify bottlenecks, user-impacting symptoms, and platform improvement opportunities.
Led the FAST project, mining real-user and synthetic monitoring telemetry to surface optimization recommendations adopted by engineering teams.
Created dashboards and reporting views that converted raw monitoring signals into actionable performance, reliability, and stakeholder insights.
Supported AWS cloud migration planning by evaluating monitoring readiness, transaction visibility, and performance reporting needs.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Served as CA APM/Introscope SME for a large financial-services environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents.
Defined monitoring standards, dashboards, alert rules, SLA thresholds, validation checks, and operational reporting artifacts for application, middleware, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Provided production troubleshooting guidance using CA APM telemetry, transaction visibility, dashboards, alerts, J2EE/WebLogic monitoring, and performance-analysis patterns.
Built Perl and KornShell automation for extracting, validating, transforming, and distributing APM telemetry, replacing manual reporting workflows with repeatable observability processes.
Delivered onboarding support, training material, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing to improve adoption of monitoring and troubleshooting practices.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed J2EE telecom applications under load to identify throughput limits, JDBC bottlenecks, thread contention, heap pressure, CPU constraints, memory issues, and garbage-collection symptoms.
Configured JMX Monitoring, Wily Introscope, and thread-dump automation scripts to improve runtime visibility during performance and production-readiness testing.
Documented performance baselines, defects, risks, telemetry findings, and remediation recommendations for engineering and release teams.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led validation and production-readiness support for a high-throughput shopping engine migration from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster.
Built C++/OCCI/OCI validation and regression testing utilities to verify correctness across millions of migrated transaction records.
Optimized SQL and Oracle access patterns for high-volume workloads while reducing physical hardware footprint by 95%.
